edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty inscription; the attributed author died in 842, and any other candidate is also of the Tang.
basis.zh: 唐代铭文，所传作者卒于 842 年，其他可能的作者亦为唐人。

note.en: An inscription of eighty-one characters for a small room, traditionally attributed to Liu Yuxi, though some scholars doubt the attribution. It is one of the shortest texts on this shelf. Notice how it ends by borrowing a question of Confucius from the Analects, what humbleness would there be, and the Analects stands on these stacks too.
note.zh: 一篇八十一字的小屋铭文，传为刘禹锡所作，也有学者怀疑作者归属。它是这一架上最短的文字之一。留意结尾借用《论语》里孔子的话“何陋之有”，而《论语》也在这座书库里。

excerpt.orig: 山不在高，有仙則名。水不在深，有龍則靈。
excerpt.en: A mountain need not be high: if an immortal lives there, it is famous. Water need not be deep: if a dragon lives there, it is sacred.
excerpt.zh: 山不在高，有仙则名。水不在深，有龙则灵。

gloss.en: 名 is used as a verb: to become famous.
靈 is to be numinous, to have a spirit in it.
斯 means this: this is a humble room.
馨 is a fragrance that carries far. The Book of Documents says that only bright virtue is truly fragrant.
gloss.zh: 馨，散布很远的香气。《尚书·君陈》有“黍稷非馨，明德惟馨”。

gloss.en: A great scholar; 鴻 is the wild goose, here ‘great’.
A commoner without office or learning.
gloss.zh: 没有功名、没有学问的人。

gloss.en: A plain zither without inlay or ornament.
Buddhist sutras, sometimes copied in gold; some read it as the Diamond Sutra.
gloss.zh: 佛经，有的用泥金书写；也有人认为指《金刚经》。

gloss.en: Strings and pipes troubling the ear: noisy music at banquets.
gloss.zh: 丝竹，弦乐器与管乐器，指宴乐。扰乱耳朵。

gloss.en: The thatched hut in Nanyang where Zhuge Liang (181–234) lived as a farmer-scholar until Liu Bei called on him three times.
gloss.zh: 诸葛亮（181—234）出山前在南阳隐居躬耕的草庐，刘备三顾于此。

gloss.en: The pavilion of Yang Xiong (53 BCE–18 CE), courtesy name Ziyun, at Chengdu in Shu, where he wrote his Book of the Great Mystery.
gloss.zh: 扬雄（前 53—18），字子云，西蜀成都人，在亭中著《太玄》。

gloss.en: From the Analects, book 9. Told that the eastern tribes were rough, Confucius said: ‘Where a gentleman lives, what roughness could there be?’
gloss.zh: 语出《论语·子罕》。有人说九夷简陋，孔子说：“君子居之，何陋之有？”

note.en: Eighty-one characters of balanced, quotable lines on a humble room; deft and memorable, though its self-praise is a little too pleased with itself.
note.zh: 八十一字，对仗工稳，句句可引；灵巧好记，只是自我称许稍显得意。
